subject: [PATCH 13/60] mm/compaction: restrict compaction to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch restricts compaction to common memory nodes, which should improve performance and reduce unnecessary work on memoryless nodes. However, the impact of this change is not entirely clear.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series restricts compaction to common memory nodes, reducing unnecessary work on memoryless nodes and improving performance.
